The vendor directly providing **Thrivebase** at **thrivebase.ai** is **Thrivebase Inc**.

### Supporting Evidence
According to the official **Terms of Service** at `thrivebase.ai`:
> *"These Terms of Service constitute a legally binding agreement made between you, whether personally or on behalf of an entity ('you') and Thrivebase Inc ('Company', 'we', 'us', or 'our'), concerning your access to and use of the https://thrivebase.ai website as well as any other media form, media channel, mobile website or mobile application related, linked, or otherwise connected thereto..."*

This is also corroborated by the site's **Privacy Policy**, which defines the Company as:
> *"Company (referred to as either 'the Company', 'We', 'Us' or 'Our' in this Agreement) refers to Thrivebase Inc."*
